description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ingus
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Devout Soul (0~2), removed after using Apex Devout Soul two times

description.name: Apex Devout Soul Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Devout Soul level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ingus]

description.name: Apex Devout Soul Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Devout Soul level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ingus]
